flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 52, P/B 8.3, DCF overvalued 26%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.81) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

threats.point: The year unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions." (annual report)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.
